geometry: Stele simple rectangulaire verticale, sur une longue marche arriere. Base rectangulaire a deux niveaux; grande dalle intermediaire legerement en retrait de la semelle.
fixed_features: Marche arriere et deux niveaux de base
material_zones: Composition bicolore: semelle et marche arriere en pierre claire tres mouchetee; dalle intermediaire et stele en pierre gris-bleu.
ambiguity: Aucun accessoire visible. Deux pierres distinctes sont visibles, et non un simple changement d'eclairage.
generation_note: Conserver la repartition bicolore et les joints entre pieces.
decisionPilote: Bicolore confirme visuellement. Zone variable retenue : stele et dalle intermediaire gris-bleu d'origine. Semelle et marche arriere claires conservees comme seconde pierre fixe; choix pilote sans multiplier les combinaisons.

specificationGeneration.geometry: a compact cinerary monument with a straight rectangular upright headstone, a wide rear transverse step, and two stacked rectangular base slabs
specificationGeneration.stoneAreas: only the main upright headstone and the upper rectangular horizontal slab, which are blue-grey granite in the source
specificationGeneration.fixedAreas: Keep the lower projecting plinth and the full rear transverse step in their original light grey-white coarse crystalline stone. Preserve both material boundaries and all joints.
specificationGeneration.extraConstraints: Do not turn the two materials into a single stone. The headstone top and sides remain straight, with no added curves, arch, ornament or inscription.
specificationGeneration.masterDescription: Preserve the simple upright rectangular headstone with a straight horizontal top, the broad transverse rear step supporting it, the rectangular upper slab in front of that step, and the wider rectangular lower plinth. Keep the light coarse-grained lower plinth and rear step as fixed secondary stone; only the blue-grey headstone and upper slab are the variable primary stone.
